title: As Wages Increase, Do People Work More or Less? A Wage Frame Effect
eligible_reason: Online/lab experiments with between-subject wage-frame conditions (PC vs LC); regressions are feols/feglm of work supply on condition dummies. No panel DiD or staggered adoption.
design_notes: Studies 1, 2A/2B, 2 follow-up and appendix studies; R code per study (feols/lm/feglm logit) comparing pay-change and load-change frames; preregistrations included.
data_provenance_note: Experimental CSV data for every study are shipped.
screener_notes: Code prescore 2 reflects feols calls; design is a randomized framing experiment.
